invariants: Canon paths stay bit-identical: every new behavior is flag-gated, default OFF; parity vs canon proven before a task ships
trading_data.db (24GB) is the read-only source of record — never write to it, never DDL it; all verification runs against fixtures/trading_fixture.db (regenerate: fixtures/make_fixture.py)
Leak-free evaluation: no feature/label may read data beyond time t; performance claims are cost-honest (fees+slippage), per-decision H-strided Sharpe, and need >=3 seeds before any promotion claim
Never pre-generate training data to disk; no disk I/O inside training loops — memory hierarchy is VRAM > RAM > disk
GPU jobs are never launched bare: XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.7, cgroup RAM cap (single job <=18G), at most ONE GPU job on the workstation
Never send live exchange orders, never read/print API keys or secrets; live-trading code paths run dry-run only without the operator in the loop
Expensive real-data validation (multi-hour training, full-timeline evals) is SCHEDULED (server/overnight one-shots), never polled inside the factory loop
JAX discipline: no lax.cond inside vmap (use jnp.where), guard divisions with jnp.maximum(x, 1e-10), static shapes in lax.scan, block_until_ready before device-to-host
